Overview

Portoviejo is a city in M with a population of 280,000. The capital of Manabí province, a coastal city with a strong agricultural tradition and growing economy. Housing costs are close to the national average. The overall cost of living is below the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 7b growing zone supports Mild — wide variety of vegetables, many fruit trees. Reported crime rates are relatively high. The population skews young, with a median age of 28.0.
